meta.title: Improve compiler string slicing
meta.body_summary: Specialize string slicing helpers for Go, Python, and TypeScript compilers and add compilation tests.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit compiler string slicing specialization closed by author ~12 min after creation with no review or comments; lacks benchmarks.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 274 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, touching compiler backends and test files. As a performance-oriented compiler specialization PR, it was closed without merge by the author shortly after opening with no reviewer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comments were provided before the PR was closed.
review_details.performance_claim: Specialized string slicing helpers for each compiler backend (Go, Python, TypeScript) should improve performance over generic slicing code.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by author tamnd ~12 minutes after creation with no merge; labeled 'codex'; no explanation given.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler code generation specialization requires deep backend knowledge; without validation or maintainer engagement, the PR was self-closed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks or profiler data; only compilation tests added.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No review, so no feedback on correctness.

core_change_summary.description: Added specialized string slicing helper functions in Go, Python, and TypeScript compilers (compile/go/compiler.go, compile/py/compiler.go, compile/ts/compiler.go) and corresponding test output files (tests/compiler/valid/slice.*.out). Also added a slice test source (tests/compiler/valid/slice.mochi).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files validate the output of the new slicing helpers.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding specialization per backend and test cases.

collaboration_trajectory: Author opened PR with compiler specialization and test, labeled it 'codex', and closed it after 12 minutes with no review or comment.
